# SRC-1 · Chore rota planning

### T001 · owner
I want a small chore rota for our flat of three: Ana, Ben and me. Every week it assigns the four chores, bins, kitchen, bathroom and hoovering, and nobody gets the same chore two weeks running.

### T002 · assistant
Should it run on your phones or on a computer?

### T003 · owner
A web page on our home server is enough. No accounts: whoever opens the page sees the rota.

### T004 · owner
The one thing that must not happen: a swap we agreed gets lost. When two of us swap chores, the swap stays until the end of that week, even if someone reloads the page.

### T005 · assistant
What should happen when someone is away?

### T006 · owner
Anyone can mark themselves away for a week. Their chores go to the other two, split as evenly as possible.

### T007 · owner
Weeks start on Monday. And no email reminders, we decided against them: a glance at the page is enough.
